articles.headline: Rescuers search rubble for survivors as Venezuela earthquakes kill at least 235
articles.summary: At least 4,300 people have been injured after two seven-plus magnitude shallow quakes hit seconds apart.
articles._summary: Rescues and prayers a day after Venezuelan earthquakes Rescuers are searching through rubble in a rush to save lives after two powerful earthquakes struck Venezuela near the capital, killing at least 235 people and injuring at least 4,300. In Caracas and the nearby coastal city of La Guaira, people could be heard calling for help from under the debris of collapsed buildings. The first 7.2-magnitude quake was followed seconds later by an even stronger 7.5-magnitude one, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS), with both occurring close to the surface, making destruction more severe. Many more people are feared dead, with others left homeless or too afraid to stay in damaged, unsafe buildings sleeping in the streets after the disaster. The earthquakes struck at 18:04 local time (22:04 GMT) on Wednesday - a national holiday in Venezuela, meaning more people would have been at home than on a normal weekday.
articles._zh_headline: 委内瑞拉地震造成至少 235 人死亡，救援人员在废墟中搜寻幸存者
articles._zh_summary: 委内瑞拉地震发生一天后的救援和祈祷 委内瑞拉首都附近发生两次强烈地震，造成至少 235 人死亡、至少 4,300 人受伤，救援人员正在废墟中搜寻，急于拯救生命。在加拉加斯和附近的沿海城市拉瓜伊拉，可以听到人们在倒塌建筑物的废墟下呼救。据美国地质调查局 (USGS) 称，第一次 7.2 级地震几秒钟后又发生了更强烈的 7.5 级地震，两次地震都发生在靠近地表的地方，造成破坏更加严重。灾难发生后，人们担心会有更多的人死亡，还有一些人无家可归，或者不敢住在受损、不安全的建筑里，睡在街上。地震发生在当地时间周三 18:04（格林威治标准时间 22:04），当时恰逢委内瑞拉的国定假日，这意味着在家中的人数比正常工作日要多。

articles.headline: Micron Rallies 15%, Apple Sinks 6% On Memory Costs: Stock Market Today
articles.summary: Micron's blowout earnings powered memory and chip stocks higher, but the broad stock market rally stalled by midday as S&P 500 slipped.
articles._summary: Micron’s blowout print confirmed that memory prices are climbing fast, a windfall for chipmakers and equipment suppliers but a fresh margin threat for the companies that have to buy those chips. The May core PCE price index rose to 3.4% on the year, while the headline PCE hit 4.1% — the highest since April 2023. Both readings matched expectations, with the odds of a Fed increase in September falling to 63% from 68% the prior day.
articles._zh_headline: 美光涨 15%，苹果因内存成本下跌 6%：今日股市
articles._zh_summary: 美光的井喷式印刷证实内存价格正在快速攀升，这对芯片制造商和设备供应商来说是一笔意外之财，但对必须购买这些芯片的公司来说却是新的利润威胁。 5 月份核心 PCE 价格指数同比上涨至 3.4%，而总体 PCE 则触及 4.1%，为 2023 年 4 月以来的最高水平。这两个数据均符合预期，美联储 9 月加息的可能性从前一天的 68% 降至 63%。
